CustomField.description: Whole months left on the engagement. Guarded against blank and past end dates.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(End_Date__c), 0, IF(TODAY() >= End_Date__c, 0, (YEAR(End_Date__c) - YEAR(TODAY())) * 12 + (MONTH(End_Date__c) - MONTH(TODAY())) - IF(DAY(End_Date__c) < DAY(TODAY()), 1, 0)))
CustomField.label: Months Remaining
